opening.speaker: A
opening.text: Five dollars says Jake can't juggle three balls for ten seconds.

answers.speaker: B
answers.text: Clock starts when all three are up.

sample_args.claim: Jake juggles three balls for ten seconds without a drop.
success_criteria: Jake keeps three balls in the air for ten seconds.
No ball touches the floor during the ten seconds.
failure_criteria: Holding two balls in one hand for more than a second.

edge_cases.question: When does the clock start?
edge_cases.answer: When the third ball first leaves Jake's hand.
